name: celiador-ai
description: Celiador's AI layer — chat and agent, wired to the Celiador daemon.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The Celiador agent reads and edits files in your workspace; every write is confirmed before it is applied.

celiador.daemonUrl.description: Base URL of the Celiador daemon the AI layer talks to.

celiador.supabaseUrl.markdownDescription: Override the Supabase/GoTrue base URL used for sign-in. Leave empty to use the value from the daemon's `GET /api/config` (self-hosted defaults to the daemon URL).

celiador.token.markdownDescription: Optional shared-secret fallback for the daemon agent endpoint (the daemon's `CELIADOR_TOKEN`). Normally leave empty and sign in with **Celiador: Sign In** — your Supabase session is used instead.

celiador.provider.markdownDescription: Where the agent runs. `daemon` (default): route through the Celiador daemon (`celiador.daemonUrl`) using your signed-in account — no client-side API key, and your plan's included usage applies. `anthropic`: unsupported escape hatch that calls Claude directly with your own key; nothing is metered and no included usage applies.

celiador.apiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key for the unsupported `anthropic` provider. Billing, usage limits and support do not apply when you bring your own key. Prefer the **Celiador: Set API Key** command, which stores it in the OS keychain via SecretStorage. Resolution order: SecretStorage → this setting → `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

celiador.autoApproveEdits.description: Apply the agent's file writes without asking. When off (default), each write to a new/changed path requires confirmation.

celiador.model.description: Claude model the agent uses. Only applies to the unsupported `anthropic` provider — in `daemon` mode the server picks the model per task.

celiador.effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent (higher = more thorough, more tokens).
